title: Product Ad Templates for Photos and Videos | AIVideosUGC
description: Browse product ad templates for photos and short videos. Pick a style, add your product photo, and receive a new image or clip in the same look. Start today.
h1: Product Ad Templates You Can Use With One Photo
lead: Product ad templates let you pick a look you like, add a shot of your own product, and get a new photo or short video in that same style.
card: Ready-made looks for videos and photos. Pick one and add your product.
intro: Each template is a ready-made style for a product photo or short video, shown with an example so you know what to expect. Choose one that fits your product and where you'll post it, like a close-up detail shot for Amazon or a drink pour for TikTok. Upload a photo of your own product, add a line about the setting if you like, and you'll get a result in the same style. Photos are square by default. Videos come in 9:16, 1:1, or 16:9 and last 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

faq.q: How do I adapt a product ad template to my item?
faq.a: Upload a sharp product photo and describe the action, setting, and crop you need. Templates set a starting composition; review each result for product drift.

faq.q: Can I adjust a template to suit my product?
faq.a: Yes. Add a line of text, like "on a marble counter" or "soft evening light," and the result leans that way while keeping the template's overall look.

faq.q: How do I choose a template for my product?
faq.a: Choose by the buyer moment you need: white background for a listing, lifestyle for context, demo for use, or a creator-style ad with an AI-generated person.
